declaration.preface:
At Rayzon Solar Ltd., we uphold the dignity, rights, and well-being of every individual connected to our operations and supply chain. Our Fair Labor and Human Rights Policy reflects our unwavering commitment to ethical labor practices, non-discrimination, and respect for fundamental human rights. We strive to create a safe, inclusive, and empowering workplace where all employees and partners are treated fairly, paid equitably, and protected from any form of abuse, harassment, or forced labor. Through continuous monitoring, responsible sourcing, and transparent engagement, we aim to foster an environment rooted in integrity, accountability, and social justice.

We also collaborate with suppliers to ensure human rights due diligence, prohibit exploitative practices such as child labor, and provide clear grievance channels. Our approach emphasizes proactive awareness-building, capacity development, and long-term partnerships that promote fair treatment and shared value across the value chain.
declaration.declaration:
To uphold and protect the fundamental rights of all employees, contractors, and workers across our operations and supply chain.

To prevent all forms of forced labor, child labor, discrimination, and harassment.

To ensure fair wages, working hours, and safe working conditions in alignment with national and international labor standards.

To promote diversity, equity, and inclusion in all employment practices.

To foster transparent grievance redressal mechanisms and protect whistle-blowers.

To engage and collaborate with suppliers on human rights due diligence and ethical practices.

To build a socially responsible culture that respects human dignity and promotes continuous improvement.

To align company practices with the UN Guiding Principles on Business and Human Rights and the International Labour Organization (ILO) standards.

To conduct regular assessments and audits to monitor labor and human rights performance internally and across the supply chain.

To raise awareness and provide training to employees and suppliers on labor rights and ethical work practices.

Company is committed to upholding the highest standards of fair labor practices and human rights across all aspects of our operations and supply chain. We strive to foster a respectful, inclusive, and safe work environment that values the dignity and well-being of every individual. Our efforts go beyond legal compliance and aim to actively promote social equity and ethical conduct.
declaration.scope: This policy applies to Factory – 1 (Kim site) of Rayzon Solar Ltd., including all employees, departments, contractors, subcontracted workers, directors, and governance bodies operating within this site. It also extends to any affiliated units or functions directly linked to Factory – 1, as applicable.

Workplace Safety and Wellness: We aim to foster a strong safety-first culture through continuous leadership involvement, open employee participation, and strict zero-tolerance for all unsafe practices across all departments.
We strive to ensure that our facility maintain full compliance with relevant national and international occupational health and safety (OHS) standards without exception.
We aim to identify and mitigate all potential workplace hazards proactively through timely risk assessments, internal audits, and detailed root cause analysis mechanisms.
We plan to integrate mental health and emotional well-being into our safety framework by offering targeted programs, counselling services, and awareness campaigns firm-wide.
We strive to enhance emergency preparedness by organizing periodic fire drills, ensuring that employees are confident in evacuation and response procedures.
We are committed to providing high-quality, job-specific PPE to all employees and ensuring its proper use through regular monitoring and training.
We aim to provide regular employee health and safety training to all of our employees, ensuring they remain informed, prepared, and compliant with evolving workplace safety standards.
Equal Opportunity, Discrimination and ha: We will implement transparent and merit-based recruitment, appraisal, and promotion systems to uphold equal opportunity at all levels.
We aim to foster a zero-tolerance environment toward any form of discrimination or harassment by ensuring prompt, confidential, and impartial redressal for all reported incidents.
We plan to conduct regular training sessions on anti-discrimination and respectful workplace behaviour for all employees, including managers and supervisors.
We aim to review and update our HR policies annually to align with the latest national and international standards on equality and non-discrimination.
We aim to do Partnership with organizations specializing in DEI (Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion) to enhance our recruitment strategies.
We aim to maintain a transparent and accessible grievance mechanism that ensures timely resolution of discrimination and harassment complaints with complete confidentiality and fairness.
Employee Growth and Career Development: We are committed to implementing structured career development programs that support continuous employee growth and foster internal advancement through mentorship, goal alignment, and long-term professional planning.

We prioritize offering personalized learning paths through digital platforms and expert-led sessions to enhance employee engagement and performance across all departments, functions, and geographic office locations.

Our goal is to conduct annual skill-gap assessments across all departments to enable targeted and impactful upskilling initiatives that directly support operational efficiency and innovation capacity.
We endeavor to promote internal mobility and cross-functional exposure to build a versatile and future-ready workforce capable of adapting to new roles and emerging technologies.
We ate focused on recognizing and rewarding skill development achievements to drive motivation and strengthen employee retention through structured recognition programs and career progression plans.
We intend to collaborate with external institutions and professional trainers to deliver industry-relevant learning opportunities that are updated annually to reflect evolving solar industry trends.
We plan to offer regular training and development programs to help employees grow their skills and build strong careers within the company.
Fair Wages and Benefits: We strive to ensure fair, competitive, and transparent compensation practices by regularly benchmarking wages, eliminating pay disparities, and aligning with industry and living wage standards.
We aim to provide a comprehensive and inclusive benefits package that supports employee well-being through healthcare, leave policies, retirement plans, and performance-linked incentives.
We plan to promote awareness and accessibility of wage-related rights and benefits by maintaining open communication, conducting periodic reviews, and offering training on compensation entitlements.
Working Condition: We are committed to maintaining clean, well-ventilated, and ergonomically optimized workspaces that promote employee well-being, operational efficiency, and sustained productivity.
We ensures that all facilities are proactively inspected, maintained, and upgraded to eliminate safety risks and maintain an organized, hazard-free work environment.
We guarantee uninterrupted access to safe drinking water, hygienic sanitation facilities, and comfortable break areas at all operational locations to uphold employee dignity and well-being.

We uphold fair scheduling practices by enforcing regulated working hours and limiting excessive overtime, in full compliance with the Factories Act, 1948, and all applicable Indian labor laws, to support work-life balance and employee health.
We maintain optimal environmental conditions—including adequate lighting, acoustics, and temperature controls—to reduce workplace stress and enhance comfort, safety, and focus throughout the workday.
Dedicated infrastructure is provided for women employees, including secure changing areas, maternity care facilities, and gender-sensitive amenities to foster an inclusive and supportive workplace.
We aim to provide comprehensive health insurance coverage to all eligible employees to ensure financial security and promote physical and mental well-being.

We are committed to full compliance with all applicable labor laws and internationally recognized standards, including ILO Conventions and the UN Guiding Principles on Business and Human Rights, to uphold safe, equitable, and legally compliant working conditions.
Social Dialogue: We are committed to fostering structured and transparent social dialogue by formally recognizing employee representatives to facilitate mutual understanding and cooperation.
We plans to institutionalize quarterly town hall meetings to discuss employee concerns, share company updates, and strengthen organizational transparency.

We aim to maintain open, ongoing communication channels between management and employees through scheduled dialogue sessions, committee meetings, and digital platforms that support collective participation.
The company strives to establish and support employee welfare committees or representative forums where concerns, suggestions, and feedback can be regularly discussed and resolved collaboratively.

We plan to promote the role of elected employee representatives by providing them with clear responsibilities, access to relevant information, and the training needed to fulfil their functions effectively.

We ensures that all employees have the freedom to associate and engage in collective bargaining, in accordance with Indian labor laws and ILO Conventions, without fear of retaliation or discrimination.
We are committed to developing a formal grievance resolution channel in consultation with employee representatives, ensuring fair and participatory handling of workplace concerns.
Ethical Labor Practices and Safeguards: Rayzon strictly prohibits all forms of child labor, forced labor, and human trafficking and remains fully committed to protecting human dignity across all operations.
We plan to implement strong age verification and identity validation procedures during the hiring process to ensure no underage individuals are employed.
The company aims to conduct regular internal assessments and risk audits to identify, prevent, and eliminate any instance of forced or involuntary labor practices.
We strive to ensure every employee receives a clear and voluntary employment contract outlining rights, duties, wages, and terms of engagement in a transparent manner.

We plan to deliver regular training sessions for HR personnel, recruitment teams, and managerial staff to strengthen their ability to detect, prevent, and respond to risks related to child labor, forced labor, and human trafficking.
We aim to maintain anonymous, safe, and accessible grievance channels where employees or stakeholders can report unethical labor practices without retaliation.

The organization plans to engage with relevant stakeholders, including NGOs, labor rights groups, and regulatory bodies, to stay aligned with international standards and legal frameworks such as ILO Conventions and the UN Guiding Principles on Business and Human Rights.
We are committed to continuously updating our labor and recruitment policies to reflect best practices and emerging risks related to modern slavery and human exploitation.
Rayzon pledges to take prompt disciplinary and legal action against any internal violations of its zero-tolerance approach to child labor, bonded labor, or trafficking.
Governance, Implementation & Oversight: The Chief Executive Officer holds the ultimate responsibility for ensuring the effective enforcement of this Fair Labor and Human Rights Policy. The daily management and oversight are delegated to the Labor Rights and Compliance Committee, which includes leaders from Human Resources, Operations, and Compliance departments. This committee is tasked with embedding labor rights principles throughout all business functions and maintaining consistent alignment with legal and ethical standards.

Our governance system requires regular reviews of labor practices, audits on employee welfare, and thorough assessments of workplace conditions covering health, safety, remuneration, and equal opportunity. Additionally, labor risk evaluations are integrated into recruitment, supplier selection, and operational processes to ensure full compliance with national laws and international labor conventions. These reviews are conducted quarterly and reported to senior management to promote transparency and foster continuous improvement.

policy.monitoring:
Our governance system requires regular reviews of labor practices, audits on employee welfare, and thorough assessments of workplace conditions covering health, safety, remuneration, and equal opportunity. Additionally, labor risk evaluations are integrated into recruitment, supplier selection, and operational processes to ensure full compliance with national laws and international labor conventions. These reviews are conducted quarterly and reported to senior management to promote transparency and foster continuous improvement.

Internal Monitoring: The Human Resources Lead compiles monthly reports on labor compliance, training, and grievance cases. Quarterly summaries are presented to senior leadership highlighting key findings and areas needing attention.

Public Disclosure: The organization publishes an annual report on labor rights performance, referencing compliance with global standards such as ILO and UN Guiding Principles, including supplier labor practices.

Issue Escalation: Significant labor concerns or incidents are escalated to the CEO and the Labor Rights Committee to ensure swift corrective action and policy refinement..

The company dedicates itself to ongoing improvement of labor practices through regular policy reviews, incorporation of emerging best practices, audit feedback, and engagement with stakeholders. Our aim is to foster a workplace culture that respects human dignity, promotes fairness, and meets evolving regulatory expectations.
policy.reviewMechanism:
This Fair Labor and Human Rights Policy is effective from the date approved by the General Manager and will remain valid until superseded or revised. A comprehensive policy review will take place at least annually or sooner as necessary due to regulatory or operational changes.

Our organization remains devoted to upholding ethical labor standards and advancing human rights across all areas of operation, ensuring responsible and respectful treatment of all employees and partners.
